instruction: Search for the paper 'Attention is All you Need' on dblp.org and open its EMNLP/NeurIPS published entry page.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to export DBLP BibTeX for 6 papers. Searched for 'Spider' on DBLP successfully, found results. Then opened terminal, tried curl API requests and wrote a Python script to automate BibTeX fetching. Got stuck automating and ran out of 50 turns without completing.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can search papers on DBLP, navigate Chrome, open terminal, run curl/pip commands, write Python scripts, switch between applications
metadata.failure_analysis: Task too complex (6 papers). Model attempted to automate via Python script instead of manually fetching each BibTeX entry. Script writing consumed most turns without producing correct output.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to just searching and navigating to one paper's DBLP entry. Model demonstrated ability to search DBLP in the trajectory.
metadata.explanation: Task requires searching 'Attention is All you Need' on dblp.org and navigating to its NeurIPS entry page. Evaluator checks Chrome URL matches the DBLP record page format (dblp.org/rec/) and contains the NeurIPS venue-specific citation key (conf/nips/Vaswani) using the official active_url_from_accessTree getter. The actual entry URL is dblp.org/rec/conf/nips/VaswaniSPUJGKP17. [Fixed: changed URL patterns from paper-title regex to DBLP citation key patterns, added venue check for NeurIPS, removed unused dblp_search.py getter]
fix_history: Fix 1: Changed URL regex patterns from '[Aa]ttention.*[Aa]ll.*[Nn]eed' (matches search page only) to 'dblp\.org/rec/' and 'conf/nips/Vaswani' (matches actual DBLP entry page URL dblp.org/rec/conf/nips/VaswaniSPUJGKP17)
Fix 2: Added venue-specific pattern 'conf/nips/Vaswani' to verify the NeurIPS entry is opened, not just any DBLP page
Fix 3: Removed unused dblp_search.py from new_functions_paths since evaluator uses official active_url_from_accessTree getter

llm_judge_reasons: Getter active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL as a string, which is the right state to verify navigation to a DBLP entry page.
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly requires ALL patterns to match via re.search, providing conjunctive verification.
Pattern 'dblp\.org/rec/' correctly matches DBLP record entry pages (e.g., dblp.org/rec/conf/nips/VaswaniSPUJGKP17), distinguishing from search result pages.
Pattern 'conf/nips/Vaswani' correctly verifies the NeurIPS venue (conf/nips) and first author (Vaswani), ensuring the correct paper's entry page is opened.
Coverage is adequate: the search step is implicitly verified since the agent must search to reach the entry page, and the URL check verifies the final navigation target.
Minor note: instruction says 'EMNLP/NeurIPS' but the paper was published at NeurIPS (NIPS 2017). The evaluator correctly checks for NeurIPS venue only, which is the right answer.
